name: smooth-research
description: Plan-driven ML research with an evidence record: testable hypotheses, compact experiment contracts, platform-independent run records, independent reviews, advice from several models and literature, kept in an embedded LatticeDB graph through one CLI.

interface.longDescription: Turn a research plan into testable hypotheses, run cheap discriminating experiments with your own tools, and keep runs, results, evidence, decisions, reviews and advice in one recoverable record.
defaultPrompt: Start a research project from plan.md with smooth-research
Resume the research project in this directory
